description.en-us: The Panda Exoskeleton is a modular mounting platform designed for Bambu Lab P/X series printers. Its lightweight metal construction and quick-release mounting system support the AMS, AMS 2 Pro, and compatible modular accessories. The sturdy frame provides a stable mounting solution, while the flip-back design allows convenient access to the printer.
description.zh-cn: Panda Exoskeleton 是一款面向 Bambu Lab P/X 系列打印机的模块化拓展架，采用轻量化金属结构与快拆设计，支持 AMS/AMS 2 Pro 支撑及多种功能模块扩展，为打印设备提供更灵活，更稳定的拓展方案。
